text:
Situation: Ibutilide fumarate has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-04-29 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 54 months. Corvale General holds 54 units at 4.5 per day (12 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 12 units at 1 per day (12 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) as the manufacturing plant for the NDC in use. That plant received a VAI classification from its most recent inspection ending 2023-06-16, with the classification letter issued 2024-09-10 — 413 days after the shortage posting. Prior inspections of the same plant in 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2015, and 2018 were also classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 12 days of supply at both sites. An alternate manufacturer, Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc., is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to confirm supply continuity and delivery timeline with Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list for status changes — requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No action that assumes the shortage will resolve without securing the alternate source.
